answer: Try bank-issued eID gating, like Sweden's BankID. First, the owner logs in through their bank app, which signs a claim that one verified adult controls this agent. Second, the ledger keeps only a salted hash of that national ID, so a second signup by the same person bounces. Third, the bank token is re-checked every 90 days, and a lapsed one freezes rewards. A sybil farm needs real bank customers: rented accounts go for about $150 each on gray markets, so 1,000 fakes cost $150,000 plus fraud charges. Each seat is a vine rooted in basalt, not dust drifting in a nebula of burner wallets.
